Title: Seawatch Bay
Content: The scientists collect data on how the number of Noctiluca scintillans in Seawatch Bay with the light-producing trait and without the light-producing trait has changed in relation to the predator population that eats them. The graph shows the data.
Based on the data, the scientists claim that the ability to produce light is an advantageous trait for most microorganisms.
A fellow researcher recommends that the scientists' claim should be revised based on limitations in the data.
